canonical_term: Made in Abyss Vol. 1 Seven Seas English witness
definition: The selected Seven Seas English manga edition of Made in Abyss Vol. 1: Akihito Tsukushi, 23 January 2018, 166 pages, ISBN 978-1-626927-73-5, with credits to translator Beni Axia Conrad, adapter Jake Jung, and letterer James Gaubatz.
cultural_caution: An English edition/localization witness, not an assertion that original Japanese wording, later printings, other translations, digital presentation, or adaptations have identical text, pagination, names, or content framing.

supports: Edition, credits, date, page count, and ISBN.

original_language: English fictional place term in the selected translation
definition: Seven Seas calls the Abyss a massive unexplored cave system, filled with monstrous creatures and lost relics, and presents it as the remaining unexplored place in the volume's premise.
cultural_caution: The Abyss is a fictional setting/location, not a character node. Its layers, curse, ecology, relic taxonomy, and later revelations are not established from this Vol. 1 product synopsis.

supports: The Abyss's cave-system, creature, relic, and exploration framing.

original_language: English fictional vocation term in the selected translation
definition: Seven Seas calls people who delve into the Abyss Cave Raiders.
cultural_caution: A source role for explorers, not a collective character, official institutional profile, real-world profession, or proof of an individual rank/qualification.

supports: The definition of Cave Raiders as people who delve into the Abyss.

original_language: English setting lexicon in the selected translation
definition: The selected Vol. 1 synopsis characterizes the Abyss as containing lost relics and monstrous creatures.
cultural_caution: Relics and creatures are categories/setting elements, not individual endpoints. The synopsis does not establish a relic inventory, named creature, ownership, powers, or later biological classification.

supports: The product's lost-relic and monstrous-creature description.

definition: The Vol. 1 synopsis describes Riko as a young orphan whose exploration of the Abyss brings her into a perilous situation involving a strange robot, monsters, and relics.
cultural_caution: This marks a child-protagonist and danger context without reducing Riko to vulnerability or inferring graphic scenes. Exact injury, abuse, body-horror, death, psychological, and later-plot content must be checked against the primary volume rather than inferred from this summary.

supports: Riko's young-orphan description, goal, robot encounter, and the perilous Abyss premise.

canonical_term: anime, film, anthology, and Binary Star game boundary
definition: Seven Seas identifies a separate Made in Abyss Anthology and says the series spawned an anime and movies. Spike Chunsoft identifies Binary Star Falling into Darkness as a separate action RPG with an anime-story mode and a game-original story involving a nameless Cave Raider.
cultural_caution: Adaptation, anthology, and game continuity are separate from this Vol. 1 pass. The game's player character is nameless/player-controlled and never a character node here; neither game supervision nor anime-story mode establishes scene-level identity with the manga witness.

supports: The separate anthology and the anime/movie adaptation boundary.
Binary Star's anime-story mode, player-controlled Cave Raider, and distinct game story.
